items.title: Confrontation reported between residents and military recruiters in Odesa
items.summary: A confrontation reportedly broke out between local residents and Ukrainian military recruitment officers in Odesa. The account says residents forced the officers to retreat, but provides no details about injuries, arrests or the circumstances leading to the dispute.

items.title: Russian Rubikon drone unit releases November 18 combat activity roundup
items.summary: A Russian military drone unit released a video roundup describing operations in Donbas, the Sloviansk and Sumy sectors, including strikes coordinated with aircraft, remote mining of Ukrainian supply routes and FPV drone interceptions. The accompanying account says the compilation contains 277 episodes, without establishing independent damage totals.
